quiet:
Returns:
    The output tensor.

  Note that the input must have rank of at least 2.

Returns:
      A list of names.

    The dtype should be a float type for this to work.

Args:
    x: input tensor.

  The data format must be one of the supported values.

Returns:
            The parsed config.

        Every required key should be present.

Returns:
        The pooled result.

    Make sure to call build() before this method.

Returns:
    Shape of the output.

  The axis should be within the valid range.

Returns:
      The decoded string.

    The bytes are expected to be valid UTF-8.

Returns:
    The new session.

  The server must be reachable for this to succeed.
